description: This file defines the LayerRuleController class, an ASP.NET Core MVC controller managing CRUD operations and ordering for layer conditions within OrchardCore's layering system. It handles authorization, condition creation, editing, deletion, and order updates, utilizing services for display management, layer management, and notifications.

classes.name: LayerRuleController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core MVC controller managing layer rule conditions, including creation, editing, deletion, and reordering, with authorization and notification support.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Displays the form to create a new condition for a specified layer and condition group.

methods.name: Create (POST)
methods.description: Handles form submission to create and add a new condition to a layer.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Displays the form to edit an existing condition identified by conditionId.

methods.name: Edit (POST)
methods.description: Handles form submission to update an existing condition.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a specified condition from a layer.

methods.name: UpdateOrder
methods.description: Reorders conditions within a layer, moving a condition to a new position.

methods.name: FindCondition
methods.description: Recursively searches for a condition by ID within a condition hierarchy.

methods.name: FindConditionGroup
methods.description: Recursively searches for a condition group by ID within a condition hierarchy.

methods.name: FindConditionParent
methods.description: Recursively finds the parent condition group of a specific condition.
